text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Incredible!! Standing in the path of the 
hero Oguri Cap is none other than this 
Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Super Creek! The winner of the Tenno Sho 
(Autumn) is Super Creek!!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, when Trainer and I get serious, 
this is roughly what we can do~.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
That was quite a nice run from you too, 
Oguri-chan. You had my heart racing for a 
second♪

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Kuh, so strong... To think they'd hang on 
that hard in the final stretch.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"Still, this isn't the end of it. Next 
time, bring both Oguri-chan and Tama-chan 
along to take me on together, okay?"

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
The decisive battle will be at the Arima 
Kinen~ To all my fans, please come watch 
the climax, okay?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I did it! Did I play the villain 
well?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. In that case, shall I give you your 
reward headpats like a true villainess?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Yes, please bow your head obediently.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, there's a good one, there's a good 
one~.

Even while acting like a villain, Super 
Creek's touch was as gentle as ever.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Just one more left. The Senior Year Arima 
Kinen. If I win that, I'll be the Queen, 
and...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
My Queen's proud Trainer is the best in 
the world♪ We will definitely make our 
dreams come true together.
